exposure: position of preventive cerclage (internal os-stitch/cervical length ratio, stitch-external os/cervical length ratio) determined by immediate postoperative transvaginal cervical ultrasound
cohort: The study included 379 women with single pregnancies who received a McDonald preventive cerclage.
finding: The position of preventive cerclage determined by immediate postoperative transvaginal cervical ultrasound was not found to be predictive of preterm birth.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 37.6 ± 3.6 weeks.
